name: zentriq-remote-support
description: Engine of Zentriq Remote Support: MeshCentral (Apache-2.0) with the modules it needs on Windows, installed at build time so the server never downloads anything.
//overrides: Patched versions of MeshCentral 1.2.5 dependencies with known vulnerabilities (npm audit, build 134), same major versions, checked by Get-RemoteSupport.ps1. image-size is a direct dependency: MeshCentral installs it on demand (branding pictures), which an offline server cannot do.
